messages:
clare: quick follow-up from the authn/authz town hall. i want to nail down service-role boundaries before we start the refactor.
omar: agree. current pain: services implicitly trust propagated api keys which makes cross-project semantics fuzzy.
reza: simple framing: two orthogonal axes 1) scope (org|project|service), 2) delegation mode (propagate|delegate). we should forbid propagate for cross-project and default to delegate.
clare: proposal: enforce at the edge: if incoming key.scope != target.scope and mode == propagate => reject. require delegate token minted by auth-proxy instead.
omar: sounds safe. what about internal controller loops where a service calls another in same project frequently? extra minting could add latency.
reza: allow short-circuit when origin.scope == target.scope: skip mint. for cross-project, mint once and cache per (caller, target, intent) with TTLs: interactive=30s, batch=10m.
clare: delegation token model: opaque id + signed attestation. example mint request: ```POST /v1/delegations {"from_key":"k_abc","to":"proj-xyz","intents":["model:invoke"],"ttl":300}``` response: {"delegation":"del_...","expires":...}.
omar: opaque token helps rotation. but for Dedicated/private we must support local verifiers. token format should include a short signature header so local verifiers can check without introspect.
reza: agreed. include a small KID header and short-lived signature (ed25519) so verification libs can validate. still opaque to callers.
clare: RBAC interplay: token allowed_intents is coarse. services must still run fine-grained checks (resource-level). but for performance-critical endpoints we can offer token-asserted roles opt-in.
omar: opt-in feature should require an admin flag and be visible in audit logs. otherwise default to server-side RBAC.
reza: migration: phase 1 (monitor) detect propagation patterns and emit warnings. phase 2 (opt-in enforcement) where proxy mints delegations automatically for cross-project calls. phase 3 (block propagate) default after 60 days.
clare: error semantics: return HTTP 403 with code DELEGATION_REQUIRED and helpful links when blocked. include origin_fingerprint and trace_id for support.
clare: ops: auth-proxy logs mint events but must never log secrets. log delegation id, requester, target, intents, trace_id. infra-bot: will add tracing header X-Delegation-Trace.
reza: SDK changes: add DelegationClient.mint(...) and TokenVerifier.verifyDelegation(token) helpers. include caching helpers.
omar: Dedicated customers: allow a pluggable mint backend and a local key provider. add config: auth.delegate_backend = local|hosted.
clare: open questions: 1) TTLs for worker flows (proposal 1h), 2) max cached delegations per origin (proposal 500), 3) audit retention default (90d, 1y enterprise).
reza: i suggest we add a hard cap on auto-mint rate per origin to avoid abuse.
clare: agreed. next steps: i'll draft a short RFC with API contract + migration timeline. rez and omar please comment on TTLs and cache limits. i'll include a sample CLI scan for propagation patterns. thanks folks. :white_check_mark:
